ruleDefinitions.name: Non-privileged Usage of Reg or Powershell
ruleDefinitions.description: Search for usage of reg or Powershell by non-privileged users to modify service configuration in registry

sequences.query: (((process_command_line = RGX(".*reg\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*add.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*powershell.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*set\\-itemproperty.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ sp\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*new\\-itemproperty.*"))) AND ((process_integrity_level = "Medium" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-8192") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*ControlSet.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Services.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*ImagePath.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*FailureCommand.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ServiceDLL.*"))))
